title: The Martyr outlook
summary: Suffering with a purpose, and an eye on the end.

claims.text: Martyrs chase personal causes and carry guilt over their own actions further than most imbued, and that colours how they understand the call.
They do not leap into death at every chance; they suffer for a purpose and choose how.
Many are so caught up in their causes that they brush other hunters aside, while others try to show fellow imbued the light of a cause by teaching or by example.
Martyrs expect to lay down their lives sooner or later, and that fatalism makes them think hard about the future rather than ignore it.
